description: Source code for exception and error handling in the torch._inductor module, including custom exception classes, error reporting functions, and environment-based behavior control.

classes.name: OperatorIssue
classes.description: Base class for operator-related exceptions, providing a method to generate a string representation of the operator call.

classes.name: MissingOperatorWithoutDecomp
classes.description: Exception indicating a missing operator without available decomposition.

classes.name: MissingOperatorWithDecomp
classes.description: Exception indicating a missing operator with an available decomposition, suggesting adding it to decompositions list.

classes.name: LoweringException
classes.description: Exception for errors during lowering process, capturing the original exception.

classes.name: SubgraphLoweringException
classes.description: Generic exception for subgraph lowering errors.

classes.name: InvalidCxxCompiler
classes.description: Exception raised when no valid C++ compiler is found.

classes.name: CppWrapperCodegenError
classes.description: Exception for errors during C++ wrapper code generation.

classes.name: CppCompileError
classes.description: Exception for C++ compilation errors, storing command and output.

classes.name: CUDACompileError
classes.description: Specific exception for CUDA compilation errors, inherits from CppCompileError.

classes.name: TritonMissing
classes.description: Exception indicating Triton installation is missing or outdated.

classes.name: GPUTooOldForTriton
classes.description: Exception indicating GPU hardware is too old for Triton support.

classes.name: InductorError
classes.description: Exception for errors related to the inductor backend, including inner exceptions.

methods.name: operator_str
methods.description: Generates a string describing the operator call with target, args, and kwargs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Various constructors initializing different exception classes with relevant messages.

methods.name: _record_missing_op
methods.description: Records missing operations to a temporary file if environment variable is set.
